description: Re-pack and save a scene, optionally to a different path (save-as). Most mutations (add_node, set_node_properties, delete_nodes, etc.) auto-save - only use this for save-as via newPath, or to re-canonicalize a hand-edited .tscn. Overwrites silently. Returns a plain-text confirmation naming the save path. Errors if the scene file does not exist. Errors while a Godot runtime session is active on this project; stop_project (or detach_project) clears it.

newPath.description: Save to a different path (relative to project) instead of overwriting the original

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Scene file path relative to the project

name: save_scene
